tours.title: Enter a song's CCLI number
triggers: where do I put the CCLI number
add the ccli song number to a song

steps.hint: Pick the song in the list, then press Edit.
Type the song's CCLI number here, then save the song.

tips.text: A song's CCLI number goes in the song editor, so your CCLI report can count it.
